hero.title: TAHTI
hero.subtitle: A fast timetable view for Turku UAS. Built around the week itself: clear events, useful details and controls that stay out of the way.

accessible.title: Accessible by default
accessible.text: Keyboard navigation, semantic controls, visible focus and screen-reader friendly schedule details.

appearance.title: System, light or dark
appearance.text: TAHTI follows your device on first use and still lets you choose a permanent appearance.

languages.title: Finnish and English
languages.text: The interface and date formatting work in both languages without mixed-language screens.

about.title: Built for the timetable
about.p1: TAHTI is a redesigned version of the existing open timetable application. It keeps the working calendar integrations, custom events and local preferences instead of replacing the data layer.
about.p2: The interface is designed to stay useful on phones, tablets and desktops and to remain understandable without relying on color alone.

styles.title: Pick a style
styles.subtitle: TAHTI can have multiple personalities. Switch between them in settings and use the one that fits your mood best.

wilma.title: Wilma style
wilma.text: Clear and familiar school-software styling that puts information first.

futuristic.title: Futuristic
futuristic.text: Glow, glass and a more modern interface mood.

oldschool.title: Old-school web
oldschool.text: A playful 90s web vibe with stronger borders and louder layout choices.

cartoon.title: Cartoon
cartoon.text: Soft, playful and more personal for everyday use.

animated.title: Animated
animated.text: Small motion details that make the interface feel more alive without becoming messy.

focus.title: Focus
focus.text: A calm mode that keeps your attention on lessons, gaps and tasks.
